tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page and tab bar background (Warm Paper / graphite near-black). Also the text color on tint fills.

tokens.name: card-background
tokens.usage: Cards and sections. Separates from the page by tone, never shadow.

tokens.name: card-secondary
tokens.usage: Nested surfaces inside a card: inputs, unselected chips, secondary containers. The third and last tonal step.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary ink: headings, body, data values. 13:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: labels, metadata, placeholders, icons at rest, inactive tabs. Reads on background, card-background and card-secondary (4.68:1 light, 4.76:1 dark at worst).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between rows and the tab bar top border. Decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Outlined input border at rest and ghost button border. Stronger than separator in dark so fields read as tappable.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of the calorie ring and progress bars.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Slate indigo, the one accent: interactive elements, active states, focus, calorie ring fill. Under 10% of any screen.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tint fill (primary button, active chip). Warm paper on indigo in light (7.8:1), near-black on light indigo in dark (7.7:1). Never #fff.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Goal-reached states only. Light value is 2.4:1 on card-background: pair it with a word or icon, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Input error border and destructive confirmation only. Swipe-delete stays tint, never red.

tokens.name: streak
tokens.usage: The 12pt streak flame glyph only (3.5:1 on card-background). No other orange outside the macro signals.

tokens.name: protein
tokens.usage: Protein macro visualization exclusively. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: carbs
tokens.usage: Carbohydrate macro visualization exclusively. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: fat
tokens.usage: Fat macro visualization exclusively. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: target-energy
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking the calories a food being picked would add to the energy target bar.

tokens.name: target-protein
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking what the food being picked adds to the protein bar.

tokens.name: target-carbs
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking what the food being picked adds to the carbs bar.

tokens.name: target-fat
tokens.usage: Pale tint marking what the food being picked adds to the fat bar.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The calorie ring center value. Used only there.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: High-emphasis data where the number is the message: consumed, remaining, burned.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card labels, section headers, screen titles, macro totals, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Food log names, descriptions, search results. 65 characters max per line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Dates, serving amounts, macro gram labels, metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, stat sub-labels such as "cal", tertiary data.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between label and bar, between stacked macro bars.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Secondary card padding, input padding, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Primary card padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Primary button horizontal padding, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Large separations between screen regions.

tokens.name: radius-sharp
tokens.usage: Macro and progress bars. Precision over softness.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons, small containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and primary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips.
